M_basis_equivalent.meaning: same free-Dirac logarithm with I_i written using M itself: hat c_M4=c_M4*(M_ref/M)^4 and hat c_M2R=c_M2R*(M_ref/M)^2, plus the a4 anomaly. Classical -4 c_M4 and -2 c_M2R are unit rewriting, not physical G or Lambda running.

beta_functions.M_ref_basis_meaning: dc_i/d ln M at fixed M_ref for this free-Dirac logarithm. M4 and M2R do not run because the subtraction keeps cutoff powers, not M^4 or M^2. That is not a physical Newton or cosmological beta function.

conventions.M: determinant normalization in ln(Lambda^2/M^2); not a fermion mass; not M_ref; not Omega
conventions.M_ref: fixed mass in the finite local basis (M_ref^4, M_ref^2 R, C^2, R^2, E4, BoxR)
conventions.Weyl_compensator: not derived here; a concurrent owner, not this M-flow
conventions.common_action: shifts of the unresolved finite local part of the same measure; no extra Einstein or scalar term
conventions.continuum_bulk_running: C2 only on this closed fixed-topology cell; Euler and box bulk EL vanish identically
conventions.curvature: R_E=-R_L; C2 and E4 from the Lorentzian finite-term owner; Box_E R_E=Box_L R_L
conventions.discrete_Euler_column: retained in finite-code cancellation to match the finite-term owner; leftover versus C2-only is product-rule error
conventions.gradient_convention: covariant-source per-node metric_gradients; variation is the inner product against delta N,q,r
conventions.initial_coefficients: unspecified remains None; symbolic names c_M4..c_boxR; an explicit numeric vector is an unfitted control, not a selected zero action
conventions.operator: massless torsionless Dirac; existing covariant frequency modulus E_Lambda
conventions.static_energy: F_i=4*pi*int N q r^2 I_i dx; S_fin=-int F dt; EL densities as in the finite-term owner

discrete_euler_refinement.classification: discrete product-rule leftover of the finite-term Euler column, not continuum bulk Euler stress

exact_identities.curvature_convention: R_E=-R_L; C2 and E4 from the Lorentzian finite-term owner; Box_E R_E=Box_L R_L
